anchorScenes.title: Rooftop
anchorScenes.narration: Every forecast starts somewhere high, dry, and windy — tonight, that's Nova's rooftop station.
anchorScenes.visual: host presenting beside a small rooftop weather station at dusk, city skyline behind
anchorScenes.mood: dusk skyline, cool blues with warm rim light
anchorScenes.caption: the station

anchorScenes.title: Street
anchorScenes.narration: And when the radar says run, Nova runs — umbrella first, questions second.
anchorScenes.visual: host walking a rain-slick street under a dark umbrella, streetlights reflecting on asphalt
anchorScenes.caption: the run

anchorScenes.title: Wrap
anchorScenes.narration: By sunset the front has passed, and the park gets the calm Nova promised at the top of the show.
anchorScenes.visual: host standing in a calm park at golden hour, relaxed, closing the segment
anchorScenes.caption: the calm
